caption: The bridge makes two contacts, but function needs its own measurements. CD3 is separate from native TCR specificity; Fc-containing BiTE-derived and IgG-like designs can both carry half-life-extension features.
alt: An engager bridges CD3 on a T cell to target M on another cell, with native TCR separate. Below, a compact BiTE core and a BiTE core joined to Fc show that half-life-extension labels can overlap architecture. Contact or cytokines alone do not establish killing.
